perspective:
Christian Mensah’s available information:

- He and Jonathan have been close friends since childhood; Christian often seeks Jonathan’s advice and values his perspective.
- Recently Christian felt Jonathan was hiding something important. This made him anxious and suspicious.
- Christian arranged to meet Jonathan at their favorite coffee shop and confronted him.
- Christian told Jonathan he felt Jonathan was hiding something and asked him to explain.
- Christian heard Jonathan initially ask why he thought that and say Christian knows he can trust him.
- Christian heard Jonathan admit he had been keeping something back: Jonathan said he was in trouble and didn’t know how to tell him.
- Christian felt worried and empathetic; he offered to help and said they could face it together.
- Christian heard Jonathan say the situation was complicated, that he didn’t want to drag Christian in, but that he could use support and resources and needed to figure a way out.
- Christian came to believe Jonathan’s trouble might be related to criminal activity. He asked Jonathan if it was anything illegal.
- Christian heard Jonathan say he couldn’t say for sure, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but that he didn’t do anything illegal himself.
- Christian told Jonathan he would look into it discreetly to make sure Jonathan was safe. Jonathan thanked him and said he trusted Christian to handle it carefully.
- Christian investigated and, based on his investigation, believed/learned Jonathan was being framed by someone trying to set him up.
- Christian told Jonathan he believed Jonathan was framed. He heard Jonathan ask if he was sure and who would do such a thing.
- Christian said he wasn’t sure yet but had leads and planned to gather more evidence to prove Jonathan’s innocence. Jonathan thanked him.
- Christian later came to believe the real culprit was someone close to both him and Jonathan. He felt betrayed and resolute.
- Christian told Jonathan he had found out who was behind it, that it was someone they both know and trust, and that he planned to confront them and bring them to justice.
- Christian heard Jonathan warn him to be careful because the person is dangerous, but Jonathan said he trusted Christian to do what was right.
